name: GNG Electronics Ltd
title: GNG Electronics Ltd - 544455 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Refurbished-PC seller reports Q4 PAT up ~3x and FY26 revenue +34%, but inventory swelled to INR743 crore and debtors rose to INR206 crore, so margin gains rest on a bet on rising component prices.

triggers.label: Inventory INR490cr → INR743cr in 12 months
triggers.quote: the same number is INR743 crore now, right?

triggers.label: Debtor days rising to ~40
triggers.quote: debtors were at about INR285 crore. That's gone down to INR206 crore as at the end of March.

triggers.label: Realisation up on component inflation
triggers.quote: the ASPs have increased from almost INR29,000 per laptop to INR30,000

triggers.label: FY27 guide ~25% revenue, +50bp PAT margin
triggers.quote: we can give at around 25% revenue growth and PAT margin expansion of around 50 basis points

triggers.label: Refurb capacity ~150k units/month
triggers.quote: We can say that we have capacity of doing around 150k units per month.

guidance.quote: we can give at around 25% revenue growth
The PAT level growth, an increment of at least 50 basis points from the current levels.
That is the trajectory we expect going forward.

prior_guidance_check.quote: as of March end, we've got that number down to about INR300 crore

red_flags.label: Inventory ~INR743cr, 3-4 months of sales, bet on price rises
red_flags.quote: this number is almost 3-4 months of quantum

red_flags.label: Debtor days stretched to ~40; credit to distributors
red_flags.quote: credit is paramount for that to happen

red_flags.label: Management rejects inventory price-fall risk without quantification
red_flags.quote: the prices are not going to go down before January 2028

red_flags.label: Margin fell QoQ in Q4 with volume push over margin
red_flags.quote: there's always a push of volume over margins

evasions.topic: Share of refurbished in distributor inventory
evasions.quote: It's difficult for me to give you a precise number, but it will be a small percentage
It's a very, very small percentage. It's a minuscule percentage
We can say that we have capacity of doing around 150k units per month.
